issue_snapshot.title: Follow-ups from #4: 2 from the review
issue_snapshot.body:
What the review and QA of PR #12 (for #4) found and did not fix there — filed as it merged, one ticket for the lot.

## From the review

Non-blocking findings the reviewer approved despite: a statement about severity, not a judgement that they are wrong.

### Signup throttling can be bypassed entirely by sending unparseable forwarding headers: signup is gated on the IP hint alone, and when clientIp() returns null the limiter receives zero keys and never engages.

> Signup throttling can be bypassed entirely by sending unparseable forwarding headers: signup is gated on the IP hint alone, and when clientIp() returns null the limiter receives zero keys and never engages.
> 
> `lib/auth/actions.ts:83`
> 
> Evidence: actions.ts:83 gates signup only on checkRateLimit({ ip }); rate-limit.ts keySpecs (lines 54-58) skips empty email and null/blank ip, so with ip=null specs=[] and checkRateLimit returns {limited:false} while recordFailure writes nothing. clientIp returns null for missing, non-IP, or over-60-char header values (covered by rate-limit.test.ts), and the first x-forwarded-for entry is attacker-controlled, so garbage in both headers reaches the null path on every request and signup stays unthrottled. Signin is unaffected (per-email primary key still applies).
> 
> Fix: Gate signup on a fallback bucket when ip is null (e.g. a fixed 'ip:unknown' key with a tight limit) so the gate always exists; or count signup attempts under the normalized email as a secondary key.

### The profile Save button has no pending/double-submit guard: double-clicking Save issues two updateProfile requests instead of the one the work order's QA script requires.

> The profile Save button has no pending/double-submit guard: double-clicking Save issues two updateProfile requests instead of the one the work order's QA script requires.
> 
> `app/profile/page.tsx:84`
> 
> Evidence: app/profile/page.tsx:46-90 is a plain server-action form with no client island and no disabled/isPending state on the Save button (line 84), unlike components/auth-form.tsx:911-918 which disables while pending and drops second submits. The writes are idempotent (same values twice), so the end state is identical — this is one redundant request per double-click, not corruption.
> 
> Fix: Give the profile form a pending state (small client island or useFormStatus) that disables Save while the update is in flight, matching the auth island.

---

**Check each one still reproduces before planning it.** They were written against the PR as it stood, and a later round can have fixed one. Some may not hold up: say so and drop them rather than implementing something that was never wrong. Split this if they turn out to be unrelated.

Depends on #4.
